headline: Linux kernel drops mandatory AI-tool disclosure as Torvalds embraces AI
summary: Linus Torvalds is now using AI to help develop Linux kernel code, a shift described as a turning point in his relationship with AI. Kernel developers have also dropped the requirement that contributors disclose AI tool usage, though Torvalds said contributors must still understand their code regardless of which tools they use.
